summary_md: **深夜开发者 LND ([@LateNightDEV123](https://x.com/LateNightDEV123/status/2115720595493282197))** highlights **Coucou**, an MIT tool that shows Claude Code, Codex and Cursor task progress in the Mac notch and lets you approve or deny permission requests there or from the iPhone lock screen ([Louis-CFM/coucou](https://github.com/Louis-CFM/coucou)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Louis-CFM/coucou: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.

relevance: Ambient monitoring and approval UX for coding agents.
